Developing a US market for products made in India

Connecting buyer expectations with production in India.

The objective

Extend business-to-business sales of handmade custom rugs and carpets, produced in India, to clients beyond the company’s home market and across the United States. The company was little known outside its home market.

Raju’s contribution

Raju was responsible for business-to-business sales. He developed clients in cities across the Midwest, the Pacific Northwest and the East Coast, among them a major interior design firm in the Chicago area, by tailoring samples to clientele, through referrals and direct outreach, and by travelling to build client relationships.

Drawing on his graphic-design background, he personally created two tools: a digital design grid that gave the weavers and tufters in India a precise reference for each design, and a standardized legend of 305 colours from which US clients chose the colours for their custom carpets.

The outcome

  • Delivered: new clients across several US regions, and the design grid and colour legend, which the company and its manufacturer adopted for their work.
  • Reported benefit: in Raju’s account, working from the grid removed ambiguity in how designs were interpreted, and he estimates that it reduced production time by one to three weeks, depending on the design.

Source: Raju Lalwani’s account.

The experience this brings

Translating buyer requirements into production instructions that teams in India can follow, and developing customers abroad for products made in India.
